en.IA para agências que trabalha os leads q: AI for agencies that works the leads you are leaving on the table
en.Sua agência cresceu, mas o comercial ain: Your agency grew, but sales still depend on you chasing people. Leads come in every day, but follow-up fails, the CRM exists and nobody follows it, and by the time you notice, the lead has gone cold. It is not a lack of clients, it is a lack of process. And that is where tailor-made AI comes in.
en.O que a IA faz numa agência: What AI does in an agency
en.<strong>Prospecção o dia inteiro em vári: Prospecting all day across several channels: Instagram, WhatsApp and email, without forgetting a single lead.
en.<strong>Follow-up automático</strong>, p: Follow-up that happens on its own, so no lead goes cold for lack of a nudge.
en.<strong>Qualificação de leads</strong>,: Lead qualification, with the team only receiving what is hot and ready to close.
en.<strong>CRM organizado</strong>, de subu: An organized CRM, from underused to the source of truth of the operation.
en.<strong>Horas devolvidas</strong>, com o: Hours given back, with the repetitive work off the team's back.
en.Por que agência precisa de IA sob medida: Why an agency needs tailor-made AI, not a generic tool
en.Cada agência tem o seu funil, o seu tom: Every agency has its own funnel, its own tone and its own closing process. An off-the-shelf tool does not understand that. BMAi maps and structures your sales process first and only then applies the technology, because AI on top of a messy process only speeds up the mess.

en.Organizamos o comercial antes da tecnolo: We organize the sales process before the technology.
en.O agente entra rodando, integrado aos se: The agent goes in running, integrated with your channels and your CRM.
We adjust based on real data.
en.A IA faz prospecção em mais de um canal?: Does the AI prospect on more than one channel? ⟪0⟫
en.Sim. O agente pode trabalhar Instagram,: Yes. The agent can work Instagram, WhatsApp and email at the same time, without forgetting a single lead, 24 hours a day.
en.Funciona com o CRM que minha agência já: Does it work with the CRM my agency already uses? ⟪0⟫
en.Avaliamos no diagnóstico e integramos ao: We assess that in the diagnosis and integrate with what you already use whenever possible, including organizing the CRM that is underused today.

en.Não. Ela assume o repetitivo (prospecção: No. It takes over the repetitive work (prospecting, follow-up, qualification) and gives the team hours back to focus on strategy and closing.
